name: Atomic structure

name: Chemical bond (covalent + ionic + metallic)
description: Sharing/transfer/delocalization of electrons forming molecules. Foundation for substrate-relevant role-filler binding analogues.

description: Transformation of reactants to products via energy barriers + transition states. Foundation for substrate-relevant transition dynamics + rate equations.

name: Chemical equilibrium
description: Forward + reverse rates equal; Le Chatelier principle. Foundation for substrate-relevant detailed-balance + Glauber dynamics.

name: Acid-base theory

name: Electrochemistry
description: Redox + electron transfer + electrochemical cells. Foundation for chemistry + substrate-relevant gradient analogues.

name: Molecular orbital theory
description: Quantum mechanical treatment of bonding via molecular orbitals. Foundation for theoretical chemistry + substrate-relevant superposition analogues.

name: Algorithm
description: Finite sequence of well-defined instructions for solving a problem. Foundation for computer science + substrate-relevant procedural primitives.

name: Data structure
description: Organized storage of data: arrays + lists + trees + hash tables + graphs. Foundation for substrate-relevant storage architectures.

name: Computational complexity

name: Turing machine
description: Theoretical model of computation. Foundation for computability theory + substrate-relevant universal computation.

name: Lambda calculus

name: Type theory

name: Formal verification

name: Information theory (Shannon)

name: Machine learning

name: Top-down attention

name: Quantum entanglement

name: Cognitive architecture
